rationale: ReferencePredicateValidator.ValidateReferences passes the referenced declaration and its kind, 'referenced' or 'assigned', the referencing declaration and its kind, and the optional user description; the rendered text names both ends of the forbidden reference and is grammatical.
codeChange: When the referenced declaration is an assembly reference (ExternalAssembly test), the text reads 'The '...' assembly reference cannot be referenced by ...', which is awkward; the report site could pass 'assembly' as the kind in that case.
